text: As the Patriots prepare to host the Steelers on Sunday looking to secure their first win of the 2026 season, the week has brought both personnel shuffling and significant injury concerns that will shape the matchup at Gillette Stadium. The good news arrives courtesy of running back TreVeyon Henderson, who declared himself "ready to go" after missing the opener with an ankle injury, but the Patriots will face a substantial void with wide receiver A.J. Brown sidelined for four weeks due to a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1. On the lighter side of the week's news, the organization made the roster move of signing offensive lineman Xavier Newman-Johnson to the practice squad while releasing Jacob Rizy, and the franchise will honor former All-Pro cornerback Stephon Gilmore on Friday when he returns to Foxborough to retire as a Patriot with a 2:10 PM press conference. Patriots owner Robert Kraft also made headlines by having Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's Gillette Stadium shows, citing concerns about what Kraft characterized as a history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery offensive to the Jewish community.
